title: Private Etymology: Designing Relational Reuse of Shared Symbols in Long-Term Human-AI Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2608.08443v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Previous studies have shown that people can develop shared symbols, partner-specific expressions, personal idioms, inside jokes, and other parts of a relational microculture. Recent work has also examined how humans and conversational AI negotiate and revise symbolic meanings. However, long-term human-AI systems still lack a clear design model for recording how a dyad-specific expression gains meaning, checking whether both sides still accept that meaning, and safely reusing the expression in later sessions.   This concept-and-prototype paper introduces Private Etymology, a machine-representable relational provenance that records how a dyad-specific symbolic expression is proposed, interpreted, negotiated, repaired, reused, revised, stabilized, contested, forgotten, or retired over time. I also propose relational reuse: reactivating a dyad-specific expression in a later session without fully explaining its meaning again.   The

translated_title: 私密词源：长期人机交互中共享符号的关系性复用设计
translated_abstract: 摘要：先前研究表明，人们能够发展出共享符号、特定伙伴的表达方式、个人习语、内部笑话以及其他关系性微观文化的组成部分。近期研究也探讨了人类与对话式AI如何协商和修订符号意义。然而，长期人机交互系统仍缺乏明确的设计模型，来记录特定二元组合表达如何获得意义、检查双方是否仍接受该意义，以及在后续会话中安全地复用该表达。本文作为概念与原型论文，引入了“私密词源”（Private Etymology），这是一种机器可表示的关系性溯源机制，记录特定二元组合符号表达如何随时间被提出、解释、协商、修复、复用、修订、稳定化、争议、遗忘或废止。我还提出了“关系性复用”（relational reuse），即在后续会话中重新激活特定二元组合表达，而无需再次完整解释其含义。
tldr: 本文提出“私密词源”作为关系性溯源机制，并引入“关系性复用”概念，旨在解决长期人机交互中共享符号表达的意义记录、验证和安全复用问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "Private Etymology" as a relational provenance mechanism and proposes "relational reuse" to address the recording, verification, and safe reuse of shared symbolic expressions in long-term human-AI interaction.
